against.head: A thin rise
against.learn: A rise on heavy volume has buyers behind it; a thin rise often fades.
against.text: Volume on the current rise runs 22% below its 50-day average: few buyers behind it.

XOM.change: A daily close below −1.9%, under the Mar 30 high, proves it wrong. So would heavy selling into the buy zone.
considered: Swings: higher highs and higher lows
Weekly stage: advancing (above a rising 30-week average)
Relative strength vs SPY: +17% in 3 months
MACD: above its signal line and above zero
Average daily range: 2.0% (normal for its year)
Pattern: breakout from a 3-week base (1.0x volume)
Market: 31% of stocks above their 50-day average and volatility elevated
Liquidity: about 2.0 billion dollars a day
XOM.gist: A stock in an uptrend at support (the 52-week high); it has confirmed a double bottom.

plan.sentence: Buy between −0.3% and +0.3% from the Oct 16 close. Target +3.1%, then +8%. Out on a daily close below −1.9%.
plan.why_t1: the 2.0 extension of the Aug 28–Sep 15 advance

standouts.head: Confirmed double bottom
standouts.learn: Two lows at the same level with a peak between; a close above the peak confirms it.
standouts.text: It bottomed twice at the same level (Aug 28 and Sep 22) and has closed above the peak between them: a confirmed double bottom.

standouts.head: Uptrend on every average
standouts.learn: Higher highs and higher lows, with price above rising averages.
standouts.text: Price is above its rising 50-day and 200-day averages, and the 50-day is above the 200-day.

standouts.head: Sitting on support
standouts.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

standouts.head: Momentum holding a bull range
standouts.learn: In uptrends RSI tends to hold 40 on dips and reach 70; in downtrends it fails near 60 and reaches 30.
standouts.text: RSI has stayed above 45 on every dip for three months and reached 75: the range momentum holds in an uptrend.

standouts.head: Buyers control the volume
standouts.learn: Volume on up days against volume on down days; above 1 means buyers trade more.
standouts.text: Over ten weeks, volume on up days is 1.4x the volume on down days.

XOM.take: XOM: it is in an uptrend on every average, and it sits on support at the 52-week high. It has confirmed a double bottom, and momentum holds a bull range. Against it, there is a thin rise. This is the kind of setup the desk wants to own.
